related.title: LSTM：記憶單元與門控寫入
related.titleEn: LSTM: memory cells and gated writes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付路由直方圖、容量溢位表與丟棄政策驗證。；40及48容量正確，溢位10及2可重現，所有有效token去向可追蹤。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver routing histograms, overflow tables and drop-policy validation.; Capacities40/48 and overflow10/2 reproduce, and every valid token is traceable.
related.difference: 畫記憶直通、候選乘輸入門及輸出門三路；明列c與h不同。；2.2及2.4正確，門0保留c，序列邊界與狀態介面無混淆。
related.differenceEn: Draw memory passthrough, gated candidate and output gate; distinguish c from h.; Results2.2/2.4 match, gate0 retains c and state/boundary contracts are clear.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每專家名義容量C=fT/E，實作需明定取整；總容量充足不保證每個專家不溢位。；教學T128,E4,f1.25；改f1.5，兩案恰整數。；C=1.25×128/4=40；f1.5時48。
簡化無忘記的單元c新=c舊+i g；記憶旁路局部導數1，門值的其他依賴另算。；教學c舊=2、i=.25、候選g=.8，改i=.5。；c新=2+.25×.8=2.2；改門值.5得2.4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Nominal expert capacity C=fT/E requires an explicit rounding policy; sufficient total capacity does not prevent individual overload.; Teaching T128,E4,f1.25 then1.5, both integral.; C=1.25×128/4=40; f1.5 gives48.

A simplified no-forgetting cell uses c_new=c_old+i g; its memory-path partial derivative is1, excluding other gate dependencies.; Teaching c_old2,input gate.25,candidate.8, then gate.5.; c_new=2+.25×.8=2.2; gate.5 gives2.4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GAN：生成器損失與模式覆蓋
related.titleEn: GAN: generator losses and mode coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付路由直方圖、容量溢位表與丟棄政策驗證。；40及48容量正確，溢位10及2可重現，所有有效token去向可追蹤。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver routing histograms, overflow tables and drop-policy validation.; Capacities40/48 and overflow10/2 reproduce, and every valid token is traceable.
related.difference: 畫z→G→D→loss，訓練G時保留通往G梯度但不更新D參數；訓練D時反過來。；兩loss正確，G/D參數更新邊界清楚，雙峰覆蓋有分組統計。
related.differenceEn: Draw z→G→D→loss; generator updates retain gradients through D without updating D parameters.; Losses match, update ownership is explicit and both modes have separate coverage statistics.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每專家名義容量C=fT/E，實作需明定取整；總容量充足不保證每個專家不溢位。；教學T128,E4,f1.25；改f1.5，兩案恰整數。；C=1.25×128/4=40；f1.5時48。
本課採非飽和生成器損失Lg=−ln D(G(z))；與原始minimax目標分開標記。；教學判別器給生成樣本機率.2，改.4；自然對數。；Lg=−ln.2=1.6094379；改.4時.9162907。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Nominal expert capacity C=fT/E requires an explicit rounding policy; sufficient total capacity does not prevent individual overload.; Teaching T128,E4,f1.25 then1.5, both integral.; C=1.25×128/4=40; f1.5 gives48.

Use the nonsaturating generator loss Lg=−ln D(G(z)), explicitly distinguished from the minimax objective.; Teaching discriminator probability.2 then.4, using natural logarithms.; Lg=−ln.2=1.6094379; at.4 it is.9162907.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
